```{r}
mono_fib_geneset_ensg <- genesets_fibrosis %>% lapply(function(x) ensemblizer_seur(x)) %>% 
  lapply(function(x) genifiy_seur(x)) %>% 
  lapply(function(x) ensemblizer_seur(x)) %>% 
  lapply(function(x) na.omit(x))  
  

mono_genset_select <- mono_fib_geneset_ensg[c(3,7,2,11,13,14)]

mono <- add_named_module_score( 
  seurat_object   = mono ,
  genesets_list_named = mono_genset_select,
  score_id = "score_fibrosis",
  nbin_ = 8
)

VlnPlot(mono, "intersect_set_score_fibrosis")
VlnPlot(mono, "overlap_set_score_fibrosis")
VlnPlot(mono, "Ayau_IPFeMp_score_fibrosis")
VlnPlot(mono, "Mors_1SPP1+MIPF_score_fibrosis")
VlnPlot(mono ,"Reyf_MCluster1_score_fibrosis")
 VlnPlot(mono, ensemblizer_seur("APOE"))


x2 <- FeatureScatter(mono, feature1 ="nCount_SCoV2", feature2 = "overlap_set_score_fibrosis")

```
